title: Ansal asset pack 2 - character, broadleaf trees, motorcycle

assets.name: Casual Character
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Includes 24 animations, specifically Walk/Run/Idle. Modern casual shirt and trousers, not a kurta; alter top geometry and palette for place fit. Quaternius official pack page and Poly Pizza creator page both CC0.

assets.name: Tall leafy tree
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Tall forked street-tree silhouette, 512px WebP texture conversion from 1024px original; EXT_texture_webp supported by Three.js GLTFLoader in modern browsers. Visual match to northern street trees is suggestive, not species claim.

assets.name: Round-canopy tree
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Simple faceted leafy broad canopy, no texture; recolor for neighborhood variation. Poly Pizza identifies model as part of Quaternius Toon Shooter Game Kit (not Ultimate Stylized Nature pack).

assets.name: Broad-canopy tree
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Simple wide-canopy shape, no texture; strong silhouette and low geometry. Poly Pizza identifies model as part of Quaternius Toon Shooter Game Kit (not Ultimate Stylized Nature pack).

assets.name: Cartoony Purple Motorcycle
assets.author: AliceCassie
assets.notes: Low-poly motorcycle, recolor purple paint to muted local palette. Original creator model marked CC0 on model page.

caveats: Character is a good rigged contemporary human baseline but is not a finished Indian-kurta avatar.
Leafy trees are visual approximations, not authenticated botanical specimens or actual roadside-tree placement.
No CC0/MIT auto-rickshaw, scooter or cycle passed source+visual verification.
Optimized tall tree uses EXT_texture_webp; ensure Three.js loader support and visual check inside final scene.
